breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Use the standard linear stress distribution where stress is proportional to the distance from the neutral axis,' directly contradicting the flawed instruction that treated bending stress as uniform over the section depth. This aligns with the ground truth prompt, which simply omits the incorrect uniform stress instruction and implies the standard flexure formula (linear distribution) should be used.
